# Radiant Vista

> Radiant Vista is a premium business and leisure hotel on Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi (Hubli), Karnataka 580030, India. It offers designer rooms and suites, the Brick and Brew restaurant, the Breeze Point rooftop bar and the Gala Vista banquet halls for weddings and corporate events.

## Key facts
- Name: Radiant Vista (also written Hotel Radiant Vista)
- City: Hubballi, also spelled Hubli (part of the twin city Hubballi-Dharwad), Karnataka, India
- Address: Plot No 04, S/No 106A, 107B, 108A & 109A, Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi, Karnataka 580030
- Proximity: Gokul Road commercial corridor, near Hubballi Airport, near Inorbit Mall Hubballi, convenient access to Hubballi Junction
- Phone: +91 83620 02487, Reservations: +91 91871 95517
- Email: reservations@hotelradiantvista.com
- Website: https://hotelradiantvista.com/

## Venues inside the hotel
- **Brick and Brew**: Vibrant in-house dining restaurant serving nostalgic food favourites with a bold, modern edge (butter chicken, gourmet dimsums, nani's dal twist) in an energetic setting with retro Bollywood music.
- **Breeze Point**: Scenic rooftop restaurant and bar offering open-roof ambience, curated cocktails, savoury dishes, and panoramic skyline views of Hubballi, with distinct spaces for romantic dinner dates and party gatherings.
- **Gala Vista**: Premier event venue and banquet halls with two dedicated spaces:
  - *Gala Vista I (Grand Banquet Hall)*: Designed for weddings, marriage receptions, and grand celebrations.
  - *Gala Vista II (Conference & Event Space)*: Tailored for corporate conferences, business presentations, seminars, and meetings.

## Accommodations
- **Classic Room**: Designer room with individually controlled air conditioning, 42-inch Smart TV, hot water kettle, work desk, and high-speed Wi-Fi.
- **Premium Room**: Spacious room featuring premium interiors, mini fridge, work desk, safe deposit locker, individually controlled air conditioning, and 42-inch Smart TV.
- **Suite**: Expansive luxury living space with separate lounge, designer interiors, satellite television, and business amenities.

## Nearby Attractions in Hubballi
- Inorbit Mall Hubballi
- Hubballi Airport (Gokul Road)
- Hubballi Junction (Railway Station)
- Unkal Lake
- Chandramouleshwara Temple
- Nrupatunga Betta
- Siddharoodha Math
- Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden
